scope: AI Engineer Markdown fetcher, private cache, local ingest, provenance and identity/versioning, CLI, required three-doc delta, recorded synthetic fixtures.
implementation: Typer ingest fetch supports HTTPS ai.engineer/www.ai.engineer transcript URLs, repeated --url for Markdown or HTML/XML/llms indexes, default homepage/sitemap/llms.txt discovery of advertised .md links.

Identifiable User-Agent; robots most-specific matching groups, longest matching path rule, Allow ties, wildcard/end anchors and percent normalization; crawl delay/request rate, minimum one-second spacing, Retry-After; redirect targets checked before requests.

Conditional ETag/Last-Modified revalidation; 304 and identical-body 200 preserve fetch date and content version. Raw bytes, URL/UTC date/hash, active metadata and immutable .objects history are private and resumable across interruptions.

Local flat frontmatter/Markdown preamble or JSONL manifest metadata, exact UTF-8 decoded character spans, Decimal source timing only, nullable unknown company/video/times, source-backed speaker override evidence.

Canonical URL/video/hash identity components plus persisted aliases; duplicate groups cannot inflate Talk count. Uncertain identity/source/revision blocks, contradictory metadata/video identity fails, including cross-run bridges.

Deterministic Talk/Segment IDs and version hashes; exact unchanged reruns write no rows. Changed source/fetch evidence creates immutable same-ID versions; fetched Talk paths reference verified immutable raw objects.

Declared input/cache roots, per-entry symlink rejection, repository/skill cache exclusion, input/output collision rejection, SQLite auxiliary-path checks; database and private artifacts restricted to owner access.

Atomic Store stage receipts retain config/input hashes/outcome/output_refs; JSON receipts also contain counts and per-input diagnostics. FAIL/BLOCKED exit nonzero and commit no partial entity output. PASS lists every written Talk/Segment row.

SPEC, ARCHITECTURE and REQUIREMENTS replace active local-only acquisition restrictions with C03 fetch/cache behavior and retain A2 no-redistribution/short quotes, C12 launch terms, and excluded hosted YouTube scraper/general channels.
24 synthetic recorded Markdown transcripts plus two synthetic recorded HTTP fixture files cover the requested behavior; existing network-blocking pytest fixture remains enabled.

assumptions: --cache and --out declare directory roots unless --root explicitly supplies an enclosing root; each nested input, manifest and cache artifact is validated. The explicit --db path declares its separate output target.

Index discovery follows advertised same-site .md links; current live AI Engineer route/layout is not asserted. Explicit --url can provide a known Markdown endpoint.
304/identical-body 200 validator updates and last_checked_at are revalidation, not new source evidence. Source URL, content hash, or fetch-date changes are version-worthy.
Metadata supports flat scalar frontmatter, conventional Markdown headings/preamble, and per-path JSONL manifests. Unsupported or ambiguous metadata blocks rather than guessing.
